findings.highlight: the unfair Servant that prepared the strongest force with his money
findings.evidenceJa: 敵は金にあかして最強部隊を揃えている
findings.governingReading: the cheating Servant whose side used lavish funds to assemble the strongest force
findings.explanation: The joke’s money-backed team-building relation is assigned directly and awkwardly to the Servant.

findings.highlight: you should at least prepare one weapon
findings.evidenceJa: こっちも一つぐらいは逆転可能な武器を用意しておくべき
findings.governingReading: our side should prepare at least one weapon capable of reversing the situation
findings.explanation: The dojo’s collective strategy becomes an instruction addressed solely to the player.
A production-format joke becomes a change in attitude.

findings.highlight: like getting a totally new graphic designer
findings.evidenceJa: ウォーズからメタルスにＣＧが変わるようなもの
findings.governingReading: like the CG changing from “Wars” to “Metals”
findings.explanation: A specific animation-generation reference and its CG mechanism are replaced by staffing.

findings.evidenceJa: やっつけ仕事な立ち絵
findings.explanation: The joke targets visibly hurried production work and a specific asset type, not general art quality.

findings.evidenceJa: そこを面！　面！　面！
findings.governingReading: Strike it on the head! Head! Head!
findings.explanation: The kendo command and repeated target are generalized.
